assets.theme: Seamless White Camellia and Glossy Tea Leaf Pattern on Pale Celadon
assets.palette: ivory camellia white, deep tea leaf green, pale celadon, soft ochre stamen
assets.prompt: Design a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless repeating botanical pattern tailored for specialty tea tins, botanical skincare boxes, and spring cotton textiles. Depict newly composed ivory-white camellia blossoms with soft golden stamens, plump unopened buds, and deep glossy serrated tea leaves arranged in a graceful half-drop botanical rhythm across a pale celadon matte paper background. Balance larger open blooms with smaller leaf clusters and open breathing space so all four edges connect seamlessly with zero visible seams, tiling bands, or rigid rows. Render in refined hand-painted matte gouache with delicate layered petal shading, subtle midrib veining, and fine natural paper tooth rather than flat coloring-book line art. Deliver an opaque raster surface pattern free of text, logos, watermarks, mockups, or decorative borders.

assets.theme: Seamless Medium-Gauge Indigo Sashiko Wave Stitch Pattern on Slub Linen
assets.palette: deep natural indigo, unbleached ecru cotton thread, soft denim slate
assets.prompt: Render a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless textile surface pattern tailored for artisanal gift wrap, bookbinding covers, and heritage craft branding. Depict traditional Japanese Sashiko overlapping wave arcs stitched in unbleached ecru cotton thread across richly woven deep indigo slub linen fabric. Keep stitch gauge distinctly medium-bold with generous spacing between concentric arcs so the running stitches remain crisp at both 4K print scale and small web thumbnails without visual moire or shimmering. Ensure all four borders align seamlessly for effortless continuous tiling. Capture authentic tactile fabric details including subtle horizontal linen slub threads, slightly organic hand-stitched dash tension, and gentle pinhole dimples where cotton yarn enters the weave. Light obliquely with soft neutral studio light to reveal honest thread relief while keeping overall luminance balanced for overlaid light headlines. Deliver an opaque raster textile texture free of text, labels, patches, logos, or watermarks.
assets.negative_prompt: text, logos, watermarks, mockups, flat digital vector dashed lines, ultra-dense fine lines causing moire, solid continuous geometric lines, plastic sheen, patchwork seams, visible tile seams, transparent background
